mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a multi-room remodel in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most multi-room remodeling projects in Berkeley, especially those involving structural changes, plumbing, or electrical work, will require permits from the city. Failing to obtain necessary permits can lead to costly delays and potential issues with future home sales. We assist our clients in navigating the permit application process to ensure all work complies with local building codes.
